read: 2026-10-18, by eye from the schematic in the Revolution Deux post
comment: Hand-drawn schematic by the author (Fred Briggs, 2012), positive ground (-9V). No designators; parts numbered left to right. Q1 is a low-gain germanium (about 50 hFE), Q2 a medium-gain silicon (about 250 hFE); no part numbers given.
uncertain: The taper letters on the 100K Filter and Aggression pots are not clear on the handwritten drawing.
Which pot is Filter and which Aggression is inferred from the circuit: pot 1 with the 2.2u cap across the 4.7n input cap (Filter), pot 2 between Q1's emitter and Q2's base (Aggression).
rows: trimmer, set for -6.6V on the collector
